Not probed for sound. Our own descriptions; shots approximate. A stitched ad hid ~360-420 s in our player. Silicon Up Close, 447K views.

lines.gist: Under the cooler is a sliver that understands nothing
It only does four simple kinds of step
Yet it runs this film, by speed alone; slowed down, a blink lasts decades
We'll build a marble adder, shrink it, live one second at its pace
Switches are ones and zeros; binary counting; everything becomes numbers
Gates from switches; a marble machine adds five and three before your eyes
Memory loop, clock, a program as numbers; the jump makes it a computer
At one tick per second, memory takes minutes, drives days, your second 160 years
Cores take turns so fast you never notice
It can't bear waiting, so it guesses the jump and keeps or discards work
Discarded guesses left traces: the 2018 Spectre attack, and the fix
From 1971's first chip to today: millions of times more, same four steps
Next time it seems slow, remember your second is a century to it

ending.lastFrame: big gold card: your one second in chip years, then credits

whyItWorks: A physical analogy machine (marbles and rockers) the viewer can watch compute, with a digit readout that flips on every event.
A single scale trick (slow the clock so one tick is one second) turns every later number into a human wait, with a mode badge kept on screen.
Clean dark UI cards in one gold accent: a list builds one card per spoken item and the named one lights up.
A late turn (the guessing trick became a security hole) re-raises stakes two-thirds of the way through.
